assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire access, heritage, ecology, accessibility, and engineering conditions are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: All parcel, building, public-space, and facility moves remain conceptual and reversible.

assumptions.statement: The overall boundary and three key areas use provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: Official polygons trigger full recutting, metric recalculation, simulation replay, and bilingual artifact regeneration.

assumptions.statement: Beijing is controlled airspace for UAS outdoor activity. No route, altitude, operator, aircraft, flight window, launch interface, special safeguard, or flight application is approved by this package.
assumptions.impact: Jingzhang nodes are digital governance and public-review interfaces by default; real flight requires separate competent-authority approval.

assumptions.statement: The concept area is within the Sixth Ring, where UAS and core-component storage is generally prohibited under the 2026 Beijing regulation.
assumptions.impact: No permanent drone depot, hangar, battery store, or routine nest is proposed; custody and test flight are linked to separately compliant sites and special safeguards.

assumptions.statement: Local receptors, acoustics, weather, ecology, communications, crowd, and emergency-landing baselines are absent.
assumptions.impact: Normalized public budgets cannot be converted into decibels, risk, carbon, availability, or flight capacity.

assumptions.statement: No project-specific lawful basis, necessity test, field of view, retention schedule, or public notice has been approved for image or sensor collection.
assumptions.impact: Public-space tests use synthetic, redacted, or non-identifying data until a human-led privacy and security assessment is completed.

assumptions.statement: No validated mission demand, response-time baseline, ground-service comparison, willingness-to-pay, or lifecycle cost is available.
assumptions.impact: Routine delivery, passenger service, and fleet-volume claims are excluded; every candidate mission must beat a documented ground counterfactual on public value.

assumptions.statement: The twelve simulation tasks and counterfactual are designed stress cases.
assumptions.impact: Results demonstrate reproducible control logic only and do not prove safety, performance, acceptance, or feasibility.
